invariants.rationale: The method always returns a (possibly empty) List, so the result cannot be null.
The method returns the original records list in all cases, never a new list.
The returned list is always the same reference as 'records', so their size must be equal.
If input 'records' is empty, the returned list (alias: result) is also empty.
The result is always a List according to the method signature and implementation.
